title: Daniel's Prayer and the Seventy Weeks

questions.question: Which prophet's writings did Daniel consult to understand the number of years for the desolation of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:2 (ESV): "I, Daniel, perceived in the books the number of years that, according to the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet"

questions.question: How many years did Jeremiah say Jerusalem would be desolate?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:2 (ESV): "must pass before the end of the desolations of Jerusalem, namely, seventy years."

questions.question: How did Daniel seek God in prayer?
options: With fasting and sackcloth and ashes
questions.correctAnswer: With fasting and sackcloth and ashes
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:3 (ESV): "Then I turned my face to the Lord God, seeking him by prayer and pleas for mercy with fasting and sackcloth and ashes."

questions.question: Who came to Daniel while he was speaking in prayer?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:21 (ESV): "the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the first, came to me in swift flight"

questions.question: Gabriel told Daniel he was greatly what?
How many "weeks" are decreed about Daniel's people and holy city?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:24 (ESV): "Seventy weeks are decreed about your people and your holy city"

questions.question: The seventy weeks are decreed to finish the transgression, to put an end to sin, and to do what else?
options: Atone for iniquity and bring in everlasting righteousness
questions.correctAnswer: Atone for iniquity and bring in everlasting righteousness
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:24 (ESV): "to finish the transgression, to put an end to sin, and to atone for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness,"

questions.question: From the going out of the word to restore and build Jerusalem to the coming of an anointed one, how long shall it be?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:25 (ESV): "there shall be seven weeks. Then for sixty-two weeks it shall be built again,"

questions.question: After the sixty-two weeks, what expects the anointed one?
options: He shall be cut off and have nothing
He shall build the third temple
questions.correctAnswer: He shall be cut off and have nothing
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:26 (ESV): "And after the sixty-two weeks, an anointed one shall be cut off and shall have nothing."

questions.question: The people of the prince who is to come shall destroy what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:26 (ESV): "And the people of the prince who is to come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary."

questions.question: He shall make a strong covenant with many for how long?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:27 (ESV): "And he shall make a strong covenant with many for one week,"

questions.question: For half of the week he shall put an end to what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:27 (ESV): "and for half of the week he shall put an end to sacrifice and offering."

questions.question: On the wing of abominations shall come one who makes what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:27 (ESV): "And on the wing of abominations shall come one who makes desolate,"

questions.question: What time was it when Gabriel touched Daniel?
options: At the time of the evening sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: At the time of the evening sacrifice
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:21 (ESV): "touched me about the time of the evening sacrifice."

questions.question: Daniel prays, "We have sinned and done wrong and acted wickedly and...?"
questions.explanation: Daniel 9:5 (ESV): "we have sinned and done wrong and acted wickedly and rebelled, turning aside from your commandments and rules."

key_verse_text: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive. O Lord, pay attention and act. Delay not, for your own sake, O my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.
